amplitude.description: Peak-to-trough amplitude of the surface noise laid over the tectonic base.

animal_density.description: Tier one animal groups per square kilometre of land, and again per square kilometre of water; higher tiers follow the pyramid

animal_tier_falloff.description: How much rarer each animal danger tier is than the one below it

atoll_weight.description: Relative chance of reef islands and atolls

beast_movement_share.description: Share of eligible creature sites that become travelling groups; wildlife is dense enough that routing every one is mostly volume

belt_width.description: Angular half-width of the collision belts raised where plates meet. Wider belts give broad cordillera; narrow ones give sharp isolated ranges.

blood_occurrence.description: Locked at zero: a hidden school cannot manifest during generation

bridge_cost.description: Extra traversal cost charged when a road segment crosses a river.

circumference_km.description: Physical distance around the world; zero keeps the world_size preset

coastal_hamlets.description: Maximum additional coastal support hamlets per city

college_count.description: Maximum magical colleges seated across the world.

crust_bias.description: Shifts the continental against oceanic balance of newly drawn crust. Negative sinks more of the world under ocean; positive raises more land.

crystal_intensity.description: How strongly the crystal character is expressed where it manifests. Paired with crystal_occurrence, which decides whether it appears at all, and crystal_extent, which sets how far it reaches.

culture_link_cost.description: Road cost budget within which two cities count as one cultural region.

dead_sea_intensity.description: How strongly the dead sea character is expressed where it manifests. Paired with dead_sea_occurrence, which decides whether it appears at all, and dead_sea_extent, which sets how far it reaches.

demonic_intensity.description: How strongly the demonic character is expressed where it manifests. Paired with demonic_occurrence, which decides whether it appears at all, and demonic_extent, which sets how far it reaches.

detail_variation.description: Rerolls surface noise without changing the master seed or the continents beneath it.

draconic_intensity.description: How strongly the draconic character is expressed where it manifests. Paired with draconic_occurrence, which decides whether it appears at all, and draconic_extent, which sets how far it reaches.

eldritch_occurrence.description: Locked at zero: a hidden school cannot manifest during generation

enchanted_intensity.description: How strongly the enchanted character is expressed where it manifests. Paired with enchanted_occurrence, which decides whether it appears at all, and enchanted_extent, which sets how far it reaches.

erosion_passes.description: How many hydraulic erosion steps run over the finished heightfield.

erosion_strength.description: How much material each erosion pass moves.

fortress_count.description: Maximum fortresses raised. A capital and a city that has fought each ask for one road fort, and two peoples a road joins for one frontier fort; this caps those asks and never raises them.

fungal_intensity.description: How strongly the fungal character is expressed where it manifests. Paired with fungal_occurrence, which decides whether it appears at all, and fungal_extent, which sets how far it reaches.

globe_radius.description: Planet radius in design space. Derived from the physical width; setting it directly bypasses circumference_km and the world_size preset entirely.

hamlets_per_core.description: Maximum support hamlets packed around each core city.

haunted_marsh_intensity.description: How strongly the haunted marsh character is expressed where it manifests. Paired with haunted_marsh_occurrence, which decides whether it appears at all, and haunted_marsh_extent, which sets how far it reaches.

haunted_sands_intensity.description: How strongly the haunted sands character is expressed where it manifests. Paired with haunted_sands_occurrence, which decides whether it appears at all, and haunted_sands_extent, which sets how far it reaches.

human_magic_limit.description: Highest magical hazard a road or settlement tolerates. Ground above it is routed around and never settled.

ice_accumulation.description: Moisture required for persistent land ice

layout_variation.description: Rerolls plate layout and crust distribution without changing the master seed, so the same world can be given a different continental arrangement.

lunar_influence.description: How strongly lunar surges sway the age lottery; zero leaves the moon a spectator

magic_enabled.description: Whether leylines, magical biomes and every system reading them run at all. Zero yields a mundane world.

moisture_bias.description: Uniform shift applied to modelled rainfall before biomes are classified. Negative dries the world toward desert.

monster_density.description: Tier one monster lairs per square kilometre of land, and again per square kilometre of water; higher tiers follow the pyramid

monster_tier_falloff.description: How much rarer each monster danger tier is; gentler than the animal pyramid so a greater lair is an event rather than a rumour, and the smallest world can still hold one

moon_nod_days.description: Nod cycle in days (which hemisphere leans in); zero lets the seed choose 17..37

moon_spin_days.description: Spin cycle in days (which meridian faces the world); zero lets the seed choose 15..63

moon_synodic_days.description: Phase cycle in days; zero lets the seed choose 26..34

moon_tilt_degrees.description: Maximum lean of the moon toward the world; zero lets the seed choose 10..35

mountain_abundance.description: Width of mountain collision belts relative to the legacy model

mountain_detail.description: How strongly collision uplift is modulated along and across a belt. Higher values break a smooth ridge into distinct massifs.

nest_density.description: Overall creature density multiplier; zero empties the world

nest_fantasy.description: Monster density multiplier; zero leaves only animals

nest_limit.description: Hard cap on habitat anchors per pass; zero lets the ground decide

nest_per_species.description: Cap on anchors for one species; zero lets density decide

nest_settlement_clearance.description: Minimum distance from settled anchors on the same layer

nomad_density.description: Candidate bands per thousand square kilometres of habitable land

nomad_occurrence.description: Overall multiplier on travelling bands; zero leaves the world settled

octaves.description: How many halvings of the base wavelength to accumulate. Octaves finer than the grid can represent are discarded rather than aliased; resolved_octaves reports how many survived.

orogeny.description: Gain on collision uplift alone. Unlike tectonic_relief it lifts orogenic belts without deepening the basins, which is how a world gets mountains that answer to its oceans.

phase.description: How far through the sixteen generation stages to run. A lower phase stops early and omits every block a later stage would have written.

pirate_intensity.description: How strongly the pirate character is expressed where it manifests. Paired with pirate_occurrence, which decides whether it appears at all, and pirate_extent, which sets how far it reaches.

plate_count.description: Tectonic plates the globe is divided into. Fewer means wider continents and longer collision belts; more means a fragmented world. It also sets the detail wavelength, so with grid size it decides how many noise octaves can resolve.

population_profile.description: Which civilization founds the first cities, or mixed to let every eligible profile compete for ground.

radius.description: Feature radius for the retired non-tectonic experiment path; recipe 3 does not read it.

rain_passes.description: How many transport steps the rainfall model takes. More passes carry moisture further inland and sharpen rain shadows.

rain_strength.description: Multiplier on the moisture each transport pass carries.

red_sands_intensity.description: How strongly the red sands character is expressed where it manifests. Paired with red_sands_occurrence, which decides whether it appears at all, and red_sands_extent, which sets how far it reaches.

relief_m.description: Physical relief budget from ocean floor to continental platform; zero keeps the tectonic_relief default

ridge.description: Blends the surface noise between rounded hills at 0 and sharp ridgelines at 1.

river_threshold_km2.description: Upstream catchment a cell must drain before it counts as a river. It is an area, so it scales as the square of world width; left absolute on a wide world every land cell becomes a river and freshwater distance collapses to zero everywhere.

road_max_grade.description: Steepest gradient a road segment may climb. Steeper ground is routed around or left unconnected.

rot_occurrence.description: Locked at zero: a hidden school cannot manifest during generation

sea_level.description: Datum offset applied to the finished heightfield. Raising it drowns coastline; lowering it exposes shelf.

seed.description: Master uint32 seed. Every subsystem derives its own stream from this, so one seed reproduces the whole world; the *_variation controls reroll a single layer without disturbing the rest.

settlement_count.description: Maximum surface cities; actual counts require habitat and productive capacity.

settlement_spacing.description: Minimum separation enforced between founded cities.

shape.description: World topology. Recipe 3 requires a globe.

size.description: Sampling grid along one edge of the sphere. This is a content control as much as a detail control: settlement count tracks cells rather than land area, so raising it yields a fuller world rather than the same world sampled finer.

sky_altitude.description: Island altitude above local ground or sea

sky_occurrence.description: Probability a magically supported cluster manifests

starlight_lakes_intensity.description: How strongly the starlight lakes character is expressed where it manifests. Paired with starlight_lakes_occurrence, which decides whether it appears at all, and starlight_lakes_extent, which sets how far it reaches.

steampunk_intensity.description: How strongly the steampunk character is expressed where it manifests. Paired with steampunk_occurrence, which decides whether it appears at all, and steampunk_extent, which sets how far it reaches.

stubbornness.description: Willingness to settle difficult ground. Read only by the retired automatic-parameter path, which recipe 3 forbids, so on this recipe the control is accepted and has no effect.

support_reach.description: How far a city reaches for the rural land feeding it. Authored against the reference world and scaled with world width.

tectonic_relief.description: Total relief budget from ocean floor to continental platform. The hypsometric profile puts the floor far below the platform, so raising this deepens basins as fast as it raises peaks.

tectonics.description: Whether plate tectonics run. Recipe 3 requires them, so this is fixed at 1 and rejects any other value.

temperature_offset.description: Uniform shift applied to the latitude and elevation temperature model. Negative cools the whole world toward ice.

villain_density.description: Cultural regions per villain permitted at or above the band; the rest stall just beneath it

villain_hold.description: Tier a seated villain falls below to lose the world; under the rise band, so a reign is long once established

villain_rise.description: Share of a region's concentrated turmoil that becomes villain tier each age; zero raises none and writes no villains block

void_occurrence.description: Locked at zero: a hidden school cannot manifest during generation

volcanic_island_weight.description: Relative chance of volcanic island chains

war_survival.description: Chance a defeated city survives a war as its victor's vassal instead of a ruin; zero keeps every loser a ruin

wavelength.description: Base wavelength of the surface noise. Octave k is admitted only while wavelength/2**k stays at least twice the cell step, so this and grid size together decide how much detail survives.

wind_bearing.description: Prevailing wind direction carrying moisture inland, clockwise from north.

witch_huts_intensity.description: How strongly the witch huts character is expressed where it manifests. Paired with witch_huts_occurrence, which decides whether it appears at all, and witch_huts_extent, which sets how far it reaches.

world_scale.description: Design-space to metre conversion for the heightfield. Rescales the planet geometry without changing which world the seed draws.

world_size.description: Preset physical scale: small, medium or large, resolving to 200, 400 or 600 km of circumference. Sets globe_radius and the terms derived from it unless circumference_km or an explicit override is supplied.

physical_scale.note: config keeps the design inputs; effective_config and every layer are in metres
